name: week
title: Weekly carrier expense review
subtitle: Fictional demo data until replaced with your approved exports. Amounts are integer cents, grouped by currency.

sections.title: bill audit
sections.sql: select charge,invoice,service,issue,currency,amount_cents from v_bill_audit where issue is not null order by charge

sections.title: credit chase
sections.sql: select dispute,name,currency,requested_cents,received_cents,remaining_cents,follow_up_on from v_credit_chase where status in ('open','submitted','accepted') and remaining_cents>0 order by follow_up_on,dispute

sections.title: renewals due
sections.sql: select service,name,decision_on,renewal_on,currency,monthly_cents from v_renewals where decision_on<=current_date+60 order by decision_on,service

name: allocations
title: Cost allocation review
subtitle: Fictional demo data until replaced with your approved exports. Amounts are integer cents, grouped by currency.

sections.title: allocation review
sections.sql: select charge,invoice,currency,amount_cents,allocated_cents,remaining_cents from v_allocations where remaining_cents<>0 order by charge

sections.title: cost centres
sections.sql: select * from v_cost_centres order by centre,currency

name: records
title: Record checks
subtitle: Fictional demo data until replaced with your approved exports. Amounts are integer cents, grouped by currency.

sections.title: invoices
